notes.title: FarmTech is in Steam Strategy Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce [i]FarmTech[/i] is taking part in Steam Strategy Fest.

While the demo for the game will not be available to play at this time, we are working hard to develop the game and deliver a playable demo in the near future. In the meantime, we would appreciate your wishlists and follows as they help us out a lot!

Stay tuned for more updates!

Steam Strategy Fest runs August 28 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to September 4 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7).
